caption:
Loose stones, no mortar, still carrying traffic.
This Roman arch bridge in Alcántara, Spain, dates to AD 104–106. Wedge stones are how Roman arches work. Which of the 7 steps surprised you most? 🏛️
#history #ancientrome #romanbridge #engineering #howitworks
pinnedComment: Extra fact: the Alcántara Bridge was built under Emperor Trajan by the architect C. Julius Lacer, and it has six semicircular arches. Source: Alcántara Bridge, Wikipedia; Carole Raddato, Following Hadrian.
